# three sets are pairwise different on every case:

#   M1 differs from M3 on C01, C02, C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10, C11, C13

# THE C2 PRODUCTION CHANGE THAT MAKES M2 OBSERVABLE
# The parent's C2 implementation mapped the emit-object options to the
# emit-object CliArgs field DIRECTLY, so the action was computed but
# never consulted and site (b) was DECORATIVE. The corrected
# implementation DERIVES the field from the action:
# This is a CAUSAL indirection: the field is what the retained C
# compilation engine reads, so a mutation of the action mapping now
# changes the field and therefore the engine's behaviour.
# The change is confined to tools/bootstrap/selfhost-driver-wp001.HC.
# The C side is NOT touched and still contains no option table, no
# option name, no arity rule and no action choice.
